title: ZA-2024-8013-CU2-1A
text:
ZA-2024-8013-CU2-1A  Council District: 12 – Lee
  CEQA: ENV-2024-8014-CE  Last Day to Act: 10-15-26
  Plan Area: Mission Hills – Panorama City – North Hills

  PUBLIC HEARING REQUIRED

  PROJECT SITE:  16500 and 16514 West Nordhoff Street, 9000 North Monogram Avenue and 9003
  North Odessa Avenue

  PROPOSED PROJECT:
  Conditional Use to allow an 8,347 square-foot first floor addition and a 4,537 square-foot second floor
  addition to an existing 2,721 square-foot church building for a total 15,605 square-feet in floor area as well
  as a reduction in rear yard setback from 25 feet to nine feet. The existing church is improved with two
  existing buildings (a 9,286 square-foot building and a 13,585 square-foot building), two state-approved
  modular classroom buildings, play areas and surface parking.

  APPEAL:
  An appeal of the May 5, 2026 Zoning Administrator’s determination which:
  1. Determined, based on the whole of the administrative record, that the Project is exempt from the
  California Environmental Quality Act (CEQA) pursuant to CEQA Guidelines Section 15301, Class 1
  (Existing Facilities), and there is no substantial evidence demonstrating that any exceptions contained
  in Section 15300.2 of the State CEQA Guidelines regarding location, cumulative impacts, significant
  effects or unusual circumstances, scenic highways, or hazardous waste sites, or historical resources
  applies;
  2. Approved, pursuant to Chapter 1A Section 12.24 W.9 and 13B.2.2 of the Los Angeles Municipal Code
  (LAMC), a Conditional Use Permit to allow a first and second-story addition to an existing church
  building located in the A2-1 Zone;
  3. Denied, pursuant to LAMC Chapter 1A Section 12.24 W.9 and 13B.2.2.D.5.b, a rear yard setback of
  nine feet in lieu of the 25 feet as required by LAMC Section 12.05 C; and
  4. Adopted the Conditions of Approval and Findings.

  Applicant:  Valley Park Baptist Church of Sepulveda
  Representative: Brad Rosenheim, Rosenheim & Associates, Inc.

  Appellants:  1. Karen Dansker

  2. Gary Lee Sornborger

  Staff:  Stephanie Escobar, City Planning Associate
  stephanie.escobar@lacity.org
  (818) 374-9923

  Christina Toy Lee, Associate Zoning Administrator
